roleTitle: Staff Development Coordinator & Infection Control Nurse (RN)
description:
We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Staff Development Coordinator & Infection Control Nurse (RN) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Oakland, MD. This vital role combines the critical functions of staff education and infection prevention, ensuring the highest standards of care and safety for our residents and team.

As an SDC/Infection Control Nurse, you will be instrumental in developing and implementing training programs for nursing staff, as well as overseeing all infection control policies and procedures. This full-time position offers a competitive hourly rate of $40-$42, reflecting your expertise and commitment to excellence.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in Maryland
Minimum of 2 years of experience in a long-term care or skilled nursing facility
Proven experience in staff development, education, or training
Demonstrated knowledge and experience in infection prevention and control practices
Familiarity with state and federal regulations related to nursing and infection control
salaryOrBonusInfo: This full-time position offers a competitive hourly rate of $40-$42, based on experience.

facilityType: Commercial and Industrial Facilities, including Healthcare settings
description:
Join a highly reputable company known for its exceptional employee retention, where many team members build careers spanning decades. We are seeking skilled Lead/Senior Commercial/Industrial HVAC Technicians to join our team, serving a diverse range of commercial and industrial facilities, including healthcare settings, across the vibrant Chicago Metropolitan Area (Illinois, Wisconsin, and Indiana). This role offers the opportunity to work with a variety of systems, including boilers and chillers, in a dynamic environment.

If you are a dedicated HVAC professional with a strong background in commercial and industrial systems and are looking for a stable, long-term career opportunity with a company that values its employees, we encourage you to apply. This position requires travel within the specified tri-state area, providing a varied and engaging work experience.
requirements: Minimum 5-7 years of experience as an HVAC Technician
At least 3 years of commercial HVAC experience, including proficiency with boilers and chillers
Ability to travel extensively within the Chicago Metropolitan Area (IL, WI & IN)
Experience working in Skilled Nursing Facilities (SNF) is a plus
salaryOrBonusInfo: Hourly rate ranges from $35.00 to $60.00, based on experience and qualifications.
